title: Performance and Load Test Cases — Runnable k6 Companion

description: k6 0.55 scripts matching the load-profile cases on qapractices.com: ramp-up/steady/spike/ramp-down stages with p95/p99 and error-rate thresholds, plus a constant-arrival-rate capacity variant and a soak configuration.
